subject: prd/init-hardening
statement: When init runs, the system shall admit only a target that is an empty directory or a repository empty of tracked and untracked content, refusing every other target by name before any write.
rationale: the destructive class dies at admission (`#D-7`, closing `#F-1`/`#F-2`)
fit_criterion: across the admission fixtures (empty dir · empty repo · repo+content · non-git+content · dirty repo), exactly the two empty shapes proceed; every refusal performs zero filesystem and zero remote mutation
